","style":"info"},"customWidth":"50","conditionalVisibility":{"parameterName":"vasolution","comparison":"isEqualTo","value":"Built-in Qualys vulnerability assessment"},"name":"text - 9"},{"type":1,"content":{"json":"## Prerequisites
The following prerequisites need to be in place before the workbook will show vulnerability findings:
1. Defender for Servers Plan 1 or Plan 2 must be enabled on the selected subscription(s). Defender CSPM can alternatively be used for agentless vulnerability scanning.
2. Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management must be enabled through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration or agentless scanning.
3. The signed-in user must have permission to read Defender for Cloud assessments in the selected subscription(s).
4. Initial vulnerability findings can take up to 12 hours to appear after vulnerability assessment is enabled.

| Additional information | Shows this and additional information about this workbook. |
